## Overview

**Subject:** L. Louise Lucas
**Role:** Virginia State Senator, SD-18
**Party:** Democrat
**Data source:** Virginia SBE campaign finance filings via VoteIQ ingestion pipeline
**Cycles on record:** 14 cycles (2012–2025)
**Total Raised:** $9,085,920

Full donor-level detail available at [vpap.org](https://www.vpap.org/candidates/252/top-donors/) and Virginia SBE.

---

## A. Key Notes

- Dominion Energy Inc. PAC is **by far the largest** single donor in Sen. Lucas's donor history, contributing $1,600,000 across multiple cycles — **nearly the entire** Utilities sector total flows from this single entity.
- The Tobacco sector represents **the dominant** industry funding source by long-term percentage, reflecting **major influence** of tobacco-related PACs on Sen. Lucas's fundraising base.
- Urban One has **the most active lobbying presence** among Sen. Lucas's top donors, with 18 registered lobbyists in Virginia — a **significant** lobbying footprint.
- Virginia SBE filings do not break this down further by individual tobacco company — the $1.9M Tobacco sector total combines multiple companies into one category.
- Full donor breakdown available at [vpap.org/candidates/252/top-donors/](https://www.vpap.org/candidates/252/top-donors/).

## F. Data Limitations

- SBE data reflects reported contributions only; late filings or amendments may not be captured.
- VoteIQ taxonomy classification is an approximation; individual donor categories may contain classification errors.
- Federal PAC contributions are not disaggregated from state totals in the current pipeline.
- This module covers Virginia SBE filings only; FEC data for federal activities is separate.
